evals.prompt: Set up a virtual environment for my Python project that has a requirements.txt file
evals.expected_output: Should inspect repository guidance and existing environments, detect the host OS, create .venv with uv or standard venv, install through the environment-specific interpreter rather than bare pip, and verify dependency health

evals.prompt: I need to set up my Node.js project with nvm 24. Create the .nvmrc file and install dependencies
evals.expected_output: Should distinguish POSIX nvm from nvm-windows, create .nvmrc with version 24, install and select Node 24, use the lockfile-preserving dependency command, and verify Node plus the package manager

evals.prompt: Start work on a new Python project. Set up the virtual environment using uv and create a pyproject.toml
evals.expected_output: Should inspect repository conventions, create .venv with uv, create the requested pyproject.toml without inventing unrelated metadata, sync dependencies, and verify the selected interpreter

evals.prompt: Set up a Go project with go.mod. Download dependencies and verify the build works
evals.expected_output: Should treat Go as a versioned toolchain rather than a Python-style venv, honor go.mod or go.work, run go mod download, build, and focused tests

evals.prompt: Start a new Rust project with Cargo.toml. Build the project and run cargo test
evals.expected_output: Should inspect for a pinned Rust toolchain, verify rustup/rustc/cargo, avoid inventing a toolchain pin unless requested, and run cargo build or check plus cargo test

evals.prompt: I'm on Windows. The plain python command opens the Microsoft Store, but this repo already has .venv-map-tools\Scripts\python.exe. Run the generator with the right environment.
evals.expected_output: Should preserve and verify the existing named environment, invoke .venv-map-tools\Scripts\python.exe directly, avoid recreating the environment or installing global Python, and verify required imports before running the generator

evals.prompt: Rust is missing on this Windows workstation. Install it for this repository and make the setup reproducible.
evals.expected_output: Should inspect repository toolchain pins and MSVC prerequisites, prefer Winget installation of Rustup over directly launching a downloaded bootstrap executable, refresh the current-shell Cargo path, select the requested or repository-pinned toolchain, and verify rustc, cargo, and a focused build
